metadata.title: RHAD45 | Practical Business Automation for Singapore SMEs
metadata.description: Choose one RHAD45 product for S$100/month: WhatsApp enquiries, customer follow-ups, review requests or reporting. Arrange a 45-minute business review.
metadata.socialDescription: Practical automation for everyday business follow-through. One selected product for S$100/month, with ongoing monitoring and support.

hero.headline: Great businesses shouldn't run on “I'll remember.”
body: A lead needs an answer. A customer should hear from you again. A happy client could leave a review. And someone needs to make sense of the numbers.
RHAD45 brings practical automation to everyday business follow-through, with your team in charge of the next step.
hero.costNote: Setup, WhatsApp/API usage and third-party software are charged separately. Scope and costs are confirmed before you proceed.

graphic.title: Keep the next step moving.
graphic.caption: Illustrative lead-response journey. Your team confirms any appointment.

demo.headline: Fast replies beat “Sorry, just saw this.”
demo.body: A new WhatsApp enquiry shouldn't depend on somebody spotting a notification. WhatsApp Lead Response acknowledges the message, collects useful information and passes the details to your team.
demo.label: Illustrative WhatsApp conversation

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Hi, I'd like to know more about your services.

messages.speaker: automated
messages.text: Happy to help. What are you looking for?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Could someone talk me through the options?

messages.speaker: automated
messages.text: Of course. When is a good time for our team to reach you?

messages.speaker: automated
messages.text: Thank you. I'll pass that along with your enquiry.

demo.result: Enquiry captured. Your team follows up.
demo.note: Illustrative example, not a live chat. An enquiry does not confirm an appointment.

provenance.headline: A practical product. An experienced team behind it.
provenance.body: RHAD45 is part of RHAD, bringing the agency's creative, technology and marketing experience to everyday business automation.
provenance.note: RHAD agency experience is separate from RHAD45 product results.

offer.headline: Fewer loose ends. Clearer next steps.
offer.body: Choose the product that addresses what your business needs most. Start with one agreed scope, with monitoring and support to keep the routine on track.

products.label: Enquiries
products.name: WhatsApp Lead Response
products.headline: Give every enquiry a useful first response.
products.description: Acknowledge new WhatsApp messages, capture the details that matter and pass the enquiry to the right person.
products.handoff: Your team takes the conversation forward.

products.label: Follow-ups
products.name: Loyalty Loop
products.headline: Make the next conversation part of the routine.
products.description: Keep customers engaged with relevant, permission-based WhatsApp follow-ups after their purchase or visit.
products.handoff: You agree when to follow up and what to say.

products.label: Reviews
products.name: Review Engine
products.headline: Give good work a chance to be heard about.
products.description: Make genuine review requests and customer feedback part of the customer journey.
products.handoff: Customers share their own honest experience.

products.label: Reporting
products.name: Dashboard Reporting & Recommendations
products.headline: Know what deserves attention next.
products.description: Bring agreed business measures into a clearer view, with reporting and recommendations to support your next decision.
products.handoff: Data sources and reporting scope are agreed before setup.

priceBlock.headline: One product. S$100/month.
priceBlock.body: Choose any one of the four RHAD45 products. Ongoing monitoring and support are included within the agreed scope.
priceBlock.costNote: Setup, WhatsApp/API usage and third-party software are charged separately. If you need more than one product, we'll confirm the scope and pricing before you proceed.

agencyBridge.headline: RHAD45 handles the follow-through. RHAD helps create more demand.
agencyBridge.body: Need help reaching more customers? RHAD's SEO, social media and marketing strategy services are scoped and quoted separately.

faq.headline: Know what you're signing up for.

items.question: Can RHAD45 work with the systems we already use?
items.answer: We check that first. We review the relevant accounts and workflows you choose to share, then confirm the supported connections, the chosen scope and what your team needs to approve before setup.

items.question: What's included in S$100/month?
items.answer: Any one RHAD45 product, with ongoing monitoring and support within the agreed scope. Setup, WhatsApp/API usage and third-party software are charged separately. You don't need all four products. If you want more than one, we'll confirm the scope and pricing before you proceed.

items.question: What happens in the 45-minute business review?
items.answer: Akash and Ashwin review your goals, current accounts and customer journey with you. Together, you'll identify where automation could help, which product is relevant and what needs to be scoped. If SEO, social media or marketing strategy deserves attention, those services are discussed separately.

conversion.headline: What can your business stop chasing?
conversion.body: Arrange a 45-minute business review with Akash and Ashwin. We'll look at what's working, what's getting missed and where a RHAD45 product could help.
